sql-01.question: Compared with the same four weeks last year, how much more did lunch bring in during the Lunch 20 promo?
sql-01.answer:
During the Lunch 20 promo, lunch brought in about $1,751 more in net sales than the same four weeks last year. That's $34,611 against $32,860, a lift of roughly 5.3%.

The promo window is August 3–30, 2026, compared with August 3–30, 2025. Both cover lunch (11:00–13:59 local) on in-store and Square Online orders, completed only [Definitions §3, The Lunch 20 Promotion; Definitions §2, Lunch]. Net sales means gross sales minus discounts minus refunds.

- **2026 promo window:** 1,414 orders, $40,261 gross, $5,373 in discounts and $277 refunded.
- **2025 same window:** 1,194 orders, $34,990 gross, $1,497 in discounts and $633 refunded.

Gross sales rose by about $5,272, but most of that gain went back out as discounts. That's why the net lift is much smaller.

sql-02.question: How many new customers did Lunch 20 bring in?
sql-02.answer:
Lunch 20 brought in 262 new customers. I counted identified customers whose first completed order ever was a Lunch 20 order. That means a completed order with the Lunch 20 discount, placed from August 3 to August 30, 2026, between 11:00 and 13:59 local time, in store or on Square Online [Definitions §3, The Lunch 20 Promotion; Definitions §2, Lunch].

There were also 331 Lunch 20 orders with no customer attached. I can't tell whether those guests were new, so they aren't in the 262.

sql-04.question: Which side dish earns us the least per unit on Uber Eats delivery, after Uber's commission and food cost?
sql-04.answer:
Pickled Vegetables earns the least per unit among sides on Uber Eats delivery. It makes about $1.55 per unit.

Fried Egg is next lowest at about $1.61 per unit. Extra Noodles and Steamed Rice both come in near $1.89.

sql-07.question: What did we net from DoorDash delivery orders in September 2026 after their commission?
sql-07.answer:
In September 2026 (local time), DoorDash delivery orders netted about $34,862.65 after commission. This covers completed orders only.

- **Orders:** 1,269.
- **Gross sales:** $49,935.79.
- **Discounts:** $2,589.19.
- **Commission:** about $12,483.95, which is 25% of gross sales. That is DoorDash's delivery rate [Marketplace Terms §2, Commission and Pricing].
- **Net:** gross minus discounts minus commission, which comes to $34,862.65.

Marketplace orders don't carry a processing fee, so none is deducted. I applied the 25% to gross sales before discounts, as the vendor definition says. The terms describe it as a share of the menu subtotal. If DoorDash charges it after discounts, the commission would be lower.

sql-08.question: Since the Seasonal Specials came back on September 1, which drink category has lost the most sales compared with the four weeks before?
sql-08.answer:
House Favorites lost the most. It sold $8,377.25 in the four weeks from Sept 1 to Sept 28, 2026. In the four weeks before, Aug 4 to Aug 31, it sold $9,097.25. That is a drop of $720.00.

sql-01.question: Compared with the same four weeks last year, how much more did lunch bring in during the Lunch 20 promo?
sql-01.answer:
Lunch net sales rose by $1,751.36 during Lunch 20 compared with the same dates last year. This covers in-store and Square Online orders only, from 11:00 to 13:59 local time. Net sales means gross sales minus discounts minus refunds.

- **Lunch 20 window (Aug 3–30, 2026):** net sales were $34,610.93 from 1,414 completed orders. Gross sales were $40,261.46, less $5,373.26 in discounts and $277.27 in refunds.
- **Same dates in 2025 (Aug 3–30):** net sales were $32,859.57 from 1,194 completed orders. Gross sales were $34,989.77, less $1,497.21 in discounts and $632.99 in refunds.

That is about 5.3% more net, or 18% more orders. Gross sales rose by $5,271.69, but most of that went back out as promo discounts.

I used the same calendar dates for last year. Aug 3, 2025 fell on a Sunday and Aug 3, 2026 on a Monday, so the weekday mix differs slightly.

- Text regulars an offer of 20% or less on items other than Seasonal Specials.
- Text regulars about the Seasonal Specials with no discount.

- It goes only to customers with a phone number who ordered in the last 90 days, or who have verified SMS consent. [Customer Messaging Policy §2, Who May Receive Texts]
- It is limited to two marketing texts per customer per month. [Customer Messaging Policy §2, Who May Receive Texts]
- Anyone who has unsubscribed is excluded. [Customer Messaging Policy §2, Who May Receive Texts]

- It goes out only between 8am and 9pm Mountain time. [Customer Messaging Policy §3, Quiet Hours]
- The offer expires within 7 days and can be used once per customer. [Customer Messaging Policy §5, Offers in Messages]
